request.query: polynomial coefficient height bound on both disjoint variable integral factors

items.name: Polynomial.isIntegral_coeff_of_factors
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] (p : Polynomial S),
  IsIntegral R p.leadingCoeff →
    p.Splits → (∀ (x : S), p.IsRoot x → IsIntegral R x) → ∀ (i : ℕ), IsIntegral R (p.coeff i)

items.name: Polynomial.isIntegral_coeff_prod
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → Polynomial S),
  (∀ i ∈ s, ∀ (j : ℕ), IsIntegral R ((p i).coeff j)) → ∀ (j : ℕ), IsIntegral R ((s.prod p).coeff j)

items.name: IsIntegral.coeff_of_isFractionRing
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {p : Polynomial S},
  IsIntegral (Polynomial R) p → ∀ (i : ℕ), IsIntegral R (p.coeff i)

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_le_of_roots_le
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing F] [inst_1 : NormedField K] {p : Polynomial F} {f : F →+* K} {B : ℝ}
  (i : ℕ),
  p.Monic →
    (Polynomial.map f p).Splits →
      (∀ z ∈ (Polynomial.map f p).roots, ‖z‖ ≤ B) →
        ‖(Polynomial.map f p).coeff i‖ ≤ B ^ (p.natDegree - i) * ↑(p.natDegree.choose i)

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_bdd_of_roots_le
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing F] [inst_1 : NormedField K] {B : ℝ} {d : ℕ} (f : F →+* K)
  {p : Polynomial F},
  p.Monic →
    (Polynomial.map f p).Splits →
      p.natDegree ≤ d →
        (∀ z ∈ (Polynomial.map f p).roots, ‖z‖ ≤ B) →
          ∀ (i : ℕ), ‖(Polynomial.map f p).coeff i‖ ≤ max B 1 ^ d * ↑(d.choose (d / 2))
